description: Fetch peer review activity for an ORCID researcher: reviewer role (reviewer, editor, chair, etc.), review type, completion dates, ISSN-keyed group identifiers, and the convening organization as ORCID records it — often the service that imported the review (e.g. Publons, Clarivate). ORCID returns no journal name; groupIssn is the key to the journal, and a review that has one is headed by it. Use to assess editorial activity, journal affiliations, and the scope of a researcher's peer review contributions. Reviews come from the researcher or from member organizations that import them; sources names who added each, and coverage varies by researcher.

orcid_id.description: ORCID iD — bare (0000-0001-2345-6789) or as an orcid.org URI (https://orcid.org/0000-0001-2345-6789). The check digit may be X or x.

name: orcid_get_peer_reviews

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `profile_not_found`: The ORCID iD does not correspond to a registered researcher. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Note when no peer reviews are found — coverage varies by researcher and publisher participation.

peerReviews.description: Peer review records for this ORCID iD.

completionDate.description: Completion date of the review (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD).

conveningOrganization.description: Organization ORCID records as convening the review, often the importing service. Identify the journal by groupIssn.

disambiguationSource.description: Source of disambiguation (ROR, GRID, RINGGOLD, etc.).

name.description: Convening organization name as ORCID records it — often the service that imported the review (e.g. Publons).

groupIssn.description: ISSN of the journal group this review belongs to, if available — the key to the journal name, which ORCID does not return.

reviewType.description: Review type (e.g. review, evaluation, grant-review, editor-report).

reviewUrl.description: URL for the review record, if available.

reviewerRole.description: Reviewer role (e.g. reviewer, editor, chair, organizer, co-investigator, co-reviewer).

sources.description: The party that added this review to the ORCID record — the researcher, or a member organization such as a review-import service or publisher. Empty when ORCID records no source.

items.description: A party that asserted this item on the ORCID record.

assertionOriginName.description: Party the source added the item on behalf of, when ORCID records one — usually the researcher, for an item added through a search-and-link tool.

name.description: Name of the person or member organization system that added the item (e.g. a university research information system, Crossref, Scopus - Elsevier). Absent when ORCID records no name.

selfAsserted.description: True when the asserting party (the assertion origin when recorded, otherwise the source) is the requested ORCID iD; false when a member organization or another ORCID user asserted the item.

reviewCount.description: Total number of peer review records returned.

title: Get ORCID Researcher Peer Reviews
